payload.name: Extract Explicit Recurring Favorites and Habits
payload.description: Use during extraction when a speaker explicitly names an activity, dish, or item they do, make, or enjoy often or call a favorite.
content: During extraction, if a speaker states they do or make a specific activity, dish, or item 'a lot', 'often', or calls it 'one of my favorites', create a durable preference or event memory for that stated habit.
Include only explicitly stated details such as frequency, cooking method, or reason; do not infer unmentioned dishes or activities.
Do not skip the fact just because it is part of a casual reply or contains no direct question; the explicit statement is sufficient evidence.
Stop after capturing the named favorite and its stated context; do not enumerate every similar habit.

solves: Construction sometimes ignores explicit statements of a speaker's recurring or favorite activities (for example, a dish they often cook) when the statement appears in casual conversation, so no durable memory is created and later questions about that preference cannot be answered.
